scope: Forecasting and forecast value under the fixed causal dispatch proxy; not final Q1-Q4 contest solutions.
pass_condition: total >= 90 and no identified unresolved hard blockers

deductions.reason: Development has 64 overlapping strata with at least 100 valid intervals and coverage deviation above 5 percentage points; no validated conditional calibration or fallback.
Cold start fails explicitly; a functioning cold-start fallback is not provided.
Validated fallback for missing or abnormal inputs is not provided.

prediction_stability.new_evidence: Static/adaptive ablation and development-only cash selection with naive fallback satisfy the previously pending two-point ablation/fallback item.

economic_proxy.interpretation: Full credit is for the frozen evidence requirements, not a claim of uniformly lower risk or statistically significant development savings.

resolved_hard_blockers: Monthly training excludes labels not complete at the issue cutoff.
First-day risk residual slicing cannot read future rows.
Shifted PV hour-block approximation is explicitly documented and consistently tested.
All 36 unlabeled year-end PV requests remain in prediction output.
CSV timestamp normalization prevents the drift-adapter runtime failure.
Planning uses a causal projection of the pending midnight interval; actual execution SOC remains continuous.

development_selection.criterion: Minimum development total cash cost only; no audit selection.

limitations: Internal rubric score is not an official contest score, award probability, or certification of completed Q1-Q4 optimization.
July-December is previously observed retrospective evidence and must not guide iterative candidate or parameter selection.
Development data selects model identities and deployment variants; same-period gains and bootstrap intervals do not remove selection bias.
Adaptive development savings have 95% intervals spanning zero for all three block lengths; emergency energy and daily cost CVaR95 increase versus naive.
Terminal energy differs across variants and is disclosed but not monetized; cash savings are not asset-adjusted economic profit.
The fixed proxy starts in February with 6000 kWh and has no January warmup; these are not final contest costs.

Load-only has lower development cash cost than adaptive in both scenarios but is a predeclared ablation, not an eligible deployment variant; selection is optimal only within the declared three-variant set.
Reported forecast interval quality belongs to the selected static models; it does not establish calibrated intervals for adaptive forecasts.
The 64 failing coverage strata overlap. No post-hoc audit calibration was performed or credited.

The parent run was interrupted before final output hashes existed. Reuse hashes verify current parent/child byte equality and training dependencies, not an independently timestamped original artifact signature.

Final independent checks recomputed daily aggregates, cash identities, boundary SOC continuity and adaptive bootstrap intervals; they did not rerun the full annual LP or independently replay every ten-minute transaction.
The 66-model reload result was supplied by the primary agent and covers one sample per saved model, not exhaustive prediction equivalence.
optional_remaining_work: Develop and validate conditional interval calibration using development-only frozen validation rules.
Implement and test cold-start and abnormal-input fallbacks.
When integrating Q1-Q4, audit the actual optimizer, transaction ledger and terminal asset treatment separately.
